property_summary: After any top-level call to getTokens, the public value variable is replaced by floor(oldValue/100000)*99999, except when totalRemaining was smaller than the old value, in which case the new value equals that smaller totalRemaining times 99999/100000 rounded down (and in all cases the product term is bounded by the old value).

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: the value of state variable `value` after a call to `getTokens(...)` completes
